# General Data Protection Regulation (EU 2016/679): scanner coverage map

<!-- generated by scripts/compliance-coverage.mjs from the framework file; do not edit by hand -->

This page lists every control the scanner evaluates for General Data Protection Regulation (EU 2016/679), taken from `scanner/src/posture/compliance-frameworks/gdpr.json`, the file the engine reads. It is regenerated from that file and checked for staleness, so it cannot disagree with what is assessed.

```bash
/compliance --walkthrough gdpr
/compliance --report gdpr
```

**6 controls** are evaluated: 6 with an automated mapping, 0 needing a person to attest. By how much a code scan can observe: 2 yes, 4 partial, 0 no.

**Scope.** SELECTIVE SUBSET. 6 articles where a code scanner can produce evidence (security of processing, data minimisation, DPIA inputs). GDPR has 99 articles; lawful basis, data-subject rights, transfers and records of processing are organisational and are NOT represented here.

| Control | Requirement | Observable in code | Evaluated from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Art.5` | Principles relating to processing of personal data (lawfulness, fairness, transparency, purpose limitation, data minimization, accuracy, storage limitation, integrity, accountability). | yes | `family:pii-exposure`, `module:privacy-taint` |
| `Art.25` | Data protection by design and by default. | partial | `module:threat-model-auto`, `module:privacy-taint` |
| `Art.30` | Records of processing activities — controller maintains a register. | partial | `module:privacy-taint` |
| `Art.32` | Security of processing — appropriate technical and organizational measures. | yes | `family:crypto-weak-cipher`, `family:crypto-tls-version`, `family:crypto-tls-no-verify`, `family:auth-missing` |
| `Art.33` | Notification of personal data breach to the supervisory authority within 72 hours. | partial | `module:fix-history` |
| `Art.35` | Data protection impact assessment (DPIA) for high-risk processing. | partial | `module:privacy-taint` |

## What this does not do

<!-- limits-verified: 2026-10-20 -->

- **It is a subset.** Only the controls above are evaluated. Everything else in the framework is outside what a code scan can observe and is not assessed here.
- **It is evidence, not an assessment.** A control reported as present means the mapped signals are clean on the last scan. It is not an attestation, a certification or a statement of compliance.
- **A control needing attestation is not evidenced.** Those controls are listed so the gap is visible, and they stay open until a person attests.
